rules.statement: A deed of gift given as dowry to a bride by her parents is irrevocable, even if it is not an inducement for the marriage.
rules.supporting_quote: The husband derives advantage from the property settled on the wife. He is relieved to some extent from the provision which he would otherwise have to make for her. If he lived amicably with his wife, her income would contribute to the expenditure of the family which would otherwise fall on him exclusively.
